in_marathi.name: Birjesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Birjesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bir' meaning 'Lord' and 'Jesh' meaning 'of Vishnu'. This name is considered to honor and invoke the protection of Vishnu.

in_bengali.name: Birjesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Vishnu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Birjesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bir' meaning 'Lord' and 'Jesh' meaning 'of Vishnu'. This name is considered to honor and invoke the protection of Vishnu.
